facility_general_rule: Formal source five-field header anchors, preceding printed record, native separator band, numeric axes and complete unique original Word ownership determine records. Unit count/Word segmentation/name length/record count do not determine the schema. Names are values, not identity keys. Every unassigned source Word must be physically disjoint under normalized closed bbox intersection; all statuses/raw-empty/points/edge contact included, unknown nonfinite geometry abstains.
remaining_applicability_limits: Only the explicit five-field 施設番号/施設名/所在地名/所有関係/摘要 schema is supported; no unknown or extra fields are guessed.
All five source fields must be present and unambiguous; duplicate codes/owner IDs or conflicting axes/rules abstain.

Portrait vertical input and geometric confidence limits remain: wide native caps, aligned field axes/font em widths, bounded cap-end overhang and close final source-to-cap gap. These are applicability limits, not universal guarantees.
Independent multiple candidate bands/headers are still rejected by the unique-plan requirement, even if future geometric proof might separate them. This was not generalized in this change.
The actual changed page still has an unrelated existing major in 75号 road table/signature order; partial improvement is not whole-page success.
source_proof: Five actual source field labels define the supported schema, numeric IDs and independent physical axes define records, native separators bound the continuation; labels do not compare facility/agency/place names or expected output.
closed_source_coverage: Every unassigned Word status/raw/empty/inverted/zero/edge box is checked; nonfinite geometry cannot prove disjointness. Same name is a value, not record identity.

legacy_decoder_datum.source: Real CFF outline/ToUnicode and original page validation; this is an encoding table entry in the existing legacy decoder, not a language/paragraph/page/name branch.
